articles.label: Interior design
articles.excerpt: A person brings a photograph of an existing space, and with it the conditions they are looking for a solution within.

quote.excerpt: I put a picture in of my room and it comes back with a completely different room.

articles.label: Habits
articles.observationTitle: Tell rest, a miss and a forgotten entry apart
articles.excerpt: An empty square can mean different things: the action didn’t happen, the person took a pause, or they simply didn’t enter the result.

quote.excerpt: But there's one pretty significant feature missing, and it's an option to pause habits and not lose your streak.

articles.label: Personal finance
articles.observationTitle: Two people have to understand the balance the same way
articles.excerpt: In a couple the budget becomes an agreement. One author describes the division of labor: he keeps the accounts, his wife does most of the buying.

quote.excerpt: My wife and I struggled for years seeking the best way to communicate our budget.

articles.label: Nutrition
articles.observationTitle: Finding food from your own kitchen
articles.excerpt: A large database does not solve the job if the usual home-cooked food, a local product or a particular item from a menu is hard to find in it.

quote.excerpt: This app gives very few options for foods for a home cook.

articles.label: Calendars and tasks
articles.observationTitle: See what really fits into the day
articles.excerpt: Meetings take up specific time and determine what is left for tasks.

quote.excerpt: I like seeing my calendar and tasks in one screen.

ideas.title: A new room. The same walls.
ideas.description: New furniture and finishes on a photo of your room. Walls, windows and doors stay where they are.

ideas.title: A plan with exact dimensions
ideas.description: A planner where dimensions can be entered as numbers and refined by hand. After a wall is edited you can see what changed around it, and a bad step can be undone.

ideas.title: Will the new sofa fit?
ideas.description: Arranging furniture at its real dimensions before a purchase or a move. You add the dimensions of the room and the items, compare layouts and check the walkways.

ideas.title: From a picture to a shopping list
ideas.description: Interior selection that leads on to real products. Every item comes with similar options, a current price and a link to a store, so you can put your own shopping list together.

ideas.title: Try the color before the renovation
ideas.description: Trying a specific paint or wallpaper on a photo of the wall. You compare options in your own room, with the window, the furniture and the other details staying where they are.
